title: War on Iran: The US could focus on economically isolating Iran
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has announced a strategic shift in how the United States is handling Iran. Instead of pursuing large-scale military attacks, the government intends to prioritize efforts to isolate the country economically. This new approach marks a significant change in the administration's policy during the ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት አሜሪካ በአንጻር የምትከተለውን ስትራቴጂ መቀየሯን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ በትልቅ ደረጃ የሚደረጉ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶችን ከመፈጸም ይልቅ ኢራንን በኢኮኖሚ ማግለል ላይ ትኩረት እንደምታደርግ ተገልጿል። ይህ አካሄድ አሁን ባለው የክልሉ ውጥረት ውስጥ የአሜሪካን የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ለውጥ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Iskoot Besenti akka ibsanitti, Ameerikaan tooftaa garaa Iran irratti qabdu jijjiiruuf murteessiteetti. Biyyi sun haleellaa waraanaa gurguddaa gaggeessuu mannaa, Iran dinagdeedhaan adda baasuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennuuf jirti. Tooftaan haaromni kun, dhiibbaa naannichaa ammaa keessatti jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa mul'isa.

title: Several people injured in sword attack at school in Sweden
english: A suspect armed with a sword attacked and injured several individuals at a high school in the Swedish town of Fagersta. Police quickly responded to the scene and took the assailant into custody, reportedly after shooting them in the leg. Authorities have locked down nearby schools while they investigate the incident and secure the area.
amharic: በስዊድን ፋገርስታ ከተማ በሚገኝ አንድ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ውስጥ ሰይፍ የታጠቀ ግለሰብ ባደረሰው ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ወዲያውኑ በመድረስ ተጠርጣሪውን እግሩ ላይ በመተኮስ በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ለመጠበቅ እና ምርመራ ለማድረግ በቅርበት የሚገኙ ሌሎች ትምህርት ቤቶችን እንዲዘጉ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Magalaa Fagersta kan biyya Swiidenitti argamtu keessatti namni goraadee hidhate tokko mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaatti miidhaa geessiseera. Poolisoonni battala bakka san ga'uun miila isaa irratti dhukaasuun shakkamaa kana to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Aangoonni mootummaa qorannoo geggeessuuf jecha mana barumsaa naannichaatti argaman biroo cufanii jiru.

title: Trump’s ‘economic D-Day’ claims first victim: Not Iran, but US markets
english: President Trump has threatened to impose severe economic sanctions and isolation on Iran, characterizing it as an 'economic D-Day' strategy. However, these threats and the ongoing closure of the Strait of Hormuz have negatively impacted US stock markets and energy prices rather than weakening Iran. As a result, the US is facing rising living costs and a record national debt exceeding $40 trillion, fueling growing domestic discontent with the conflict.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እና ጫና እንደሚጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ይህ ስጋት እና የሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያ መዘጋት ኢራንን ከመጉዳት ይልቅ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የገበያ እንቅስቃሴ እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል። በዚህ ምክንያት አሜሪካ በከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነት እና ከ40 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ በሆነ የብድር ዕዳ ውስጥ በመውደቋ በሀገር ውስጥ ተቃውሞ እየገጠማት ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Tiraamp tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa fi kophaa ishee baasu kan 'economic D-Day' jedhaniin Iran irratti fudhachuuf doorsisaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, doorsisni kun fi cufamuu daandii galaana Hormuz Iran miidhuu mannaa gabaa fi gatii boba'aa Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessiseera. Kanaan kan ka'es, Ameerikaan baasii jireenyaa olka'aa fi liqii biyyoolessaa tiraayiliyoona 40 ol ta'een rakkachaa waan jirtuuf, lola kana irratti mormiin biyya keessaa dabalaa dhufeera.

title: Ebola outbreak ‘growing faster, ⁠⁠wider’ as DRC death toll passes 2,500: UN
english: The United Nations reports that the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, with the death toll now exceeding 2,500. Control efforts are being severely hindered by ongoing local conflict, violence against medical personnel, and critical funding shortages. Officials warn that without increased international support and resources, the disease threatens to spread beyond the region's borders.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ መሆኑን እና የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ2,500 በላይ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። በክልሉ ያለው ግጭት፣ በጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች እና የገንዘብ እጥረት የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመግታት የሚደረገውን ጥረት እያስተጓጎሉ ይገኛል። አስፈላጊው ድጋፍ ካልተደረገ ወረርሽኙ ወደ ጎረቤት አገራት የመዛመት ስጋት እንዳለው ባለሙያዎች አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomani akka ibsetti, dhibeen vaayirasii Ibolaa biyya Koongoo keessatti saffisaan babal'achaa jiraachuu fi namoonni 2,500 ol ta'an du'uu beeksiseera. Sochiin dhibee kana to'achuuf godhamaa jiru walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa, miidhaa hojjettoota fayyaa irratti raawwatamu fi rakkoo baajataatiin gufataa jira. Dabalataan, deeggarsi idil-addunyaa yoo hin taasifamne dhibeen kun biyyoota ollaa keessattis akka babal'atu ibsameera.

title: Liverpool preview: Five key questions heading into 2026-27 season
english: Liverpool is entering the 2026-27 season with a new head coach, Andoni Iraola, who aims to restore the team's competitive edge after a disappointing fifth-place finish last year. The squad is transitioning following the departure of club legend Mohamed Salah, shifting their focus toward younger players like Victor Munoz to revitalize the attack. Additionally, the team hopes that key stars Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz will overcome previous injuries and inconsistent form to help the club challenge for the title once again.
amharic: ሊቨርፑል አዲሱን የ2026-27 የውድድር ዘመን በዋና አሰልጣኝ አንድኒ ኢራኦላ እየጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ቡድኑ ባለፈው ዓመት ያሳየውን ደካማ አቋም በማሻሻል ወደ አሸናፊነት ለመመለስ ግብ አድርጓል። ክለቡ የረጅም ጊዜ ኮከቡን መሐመድ ሳላህን ከተሰናበተ በኋላ፣ በአጥቂ መስመሩ ላይ አዳዲስ ወጣት ተጫዋቾችን በመጠቀም ለውጥ ለማምጣት እየሞከረ ነው። በተጨማሪም እንደ አሌክሳንደር ኢሳክ እና ፍሎሪያን ዊርትዝ ያሉ ቁልፍ ተጫዋቾች ከጉዳት አገግመው ቡድኑን ለዋንጫ ውድድር እንዲያበቁት ትልቅ ተስፋ ተጥሎባቸዋል።
oromo: Liiverpuul sagantaa kubbaa miilaa bara 2026-27 kan jalqabeen leenjisaa haaraa Andonii Iraolaa waliin yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaanii dorgommii darbe keessatti sadarkaa shanffaarratti xumuruun booda gara injifannoo fi sadarkaa duraatti deebi'uudha. Taphaticha seenaa qabeessa kan ta'e Mohamed Salah erga gadi lakkisee booda, kilabichi dargaggoota akka Victor Munoz fayyadamuun weerara isaanii haaromsachuuf yaalaa jira. Akkasumas, taphattoonni gurguddoon akka Alexander Isak fi Florian Wirtz miidhaa irra turan irraa fayyanii, kilabicha dorgommii waancaa keessatti akka cimsan abdii guddaa qabu.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is rooted in a deeply ingrained social culture that prioritizes blind obedience over critical thinking. From a young age, individuals are conditioned to view questioning authority as disloyalty, a pattern that is reinforced in families, schools, and professional settings. This widespread hierarchical mindset prevents open dialogue and collective cooperation, ultimately hindering the development of a healthy democratic society.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዴሞክራሲ ፈተናዎች የሚመነጩት ጥያቄን እንደ አለመታዘዝ በሚቆጥር እና ለስልጣን ያለ ቅድመ ሁኔታ መገዛትን በሚያበረታታ ጥልቅ ማህበራዊ ባህል ነው። ህጻናት በቤተሰብ፣ በትምህርት ቤት እና በስራ ቦታዎች የሚያድጉት እነዚህን ተዋረድ መሰረት ያደረጉ የአኗኗር ዘይቤዎችን በመውረስ ነው፤ ይህም ለውይይት እና ለጋራ መግባባት ትልቅ እንቅፋት ሆኗል። በዚህ ምክንያት፣ ሀገሪቱ የዴሞክራሲያዊ ስርአትን ለመገንባት በምትጥርበት ወቅት፣ እነዚህ በስር የሰደዱ የባህሪ አመለካከቶች ትልቅ ተግዳሮት ሆነው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Rakkoon dimokiraasii Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu aadaa hawaasaa kan gaaffii kaasuun akka gantummaatti ilaalamu irratti kan hundaa'eedha. Ijoollummaadhaa kaasee namoonni aboo fudhatanii hojjechuu fi ajajamuuf kan barsiifaman yoo ta'u, amalli kun maatii, mana barnootaa fi bakka hojii keessatti guddachaa deema. Ijaarsa hawaasaa kanarratti hundaa'uun yaada walii-galtee irratti hin hundoofne uumuu fi wal-falmuu dhabuun rakkoo dimokiraasii biyyattii ta'ee jira.

title: El Nino set to be most intense ‘for over a century’: UK forecasters
english: UK meteorologists have warned that the current El Nino event is poised to be the strongest in over 100 years, with ocean temperatures expected to rise by a record-breaking 3 degrees Celsius. This unprecedented phenomenon is likely to trigger severe global weather issues, including intense droughts, massive wildfires, and catastrophic rainfall. Experts suggest that the combination of this event and long-term climate change will make 2026 a uniquely challenging year for environmental stability worldwide.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የአየር ሁኔታ ባለሙያዎች የአሁኑ የኤል ኒኖ ክስተት ከ100 ዓመታት በላይ በታሪክ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ሊደርስ እንደሚችል አስጠነቀቁ። የባህር ወለል ሙቀት በሶስት ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ ሊጨምር እንደሚችል የተጠበቀ ሲሆን ይህም በዓለም ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ ድርቅን፣ የዱር እሳቶችን እና ከባድ ዝናብን ጨምሮ አስከፊ የአየር ንብረት ችግሮችን ሊያስከትል ይችላል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ይህ ክስተት ከአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ጋር ተዳምሮ የ2026 ዓመት ለአለም አቀፍ የአየር ሁኔታ በጣም አስቸጋሪ ጊዜ እንደሚሆን ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni qilleensa UK akka akeekkachiisanitti, hanga ammaatti kan jiru 'El Nino' waggaa 100 ol keessatti kan hin mul'anne hamma baay'ee cimaa ta'e akka ta'uuf deema. Ho'i bishaan galaanaa digrii Selsiyeesii sadiin ol dabaluun isaa, addunyaa irratti hongee cimaa, ibidda bosonaa fi rooba garmalee guddachaa deemu fiduu danda'a. Qorattoonni akka jedhanitti, dhukkubni kun jijjiirama qilleensa addunyaa waliin walitti makamee, bara 2026 qilleensa addunyaa irratti balaa haaraa fi cimaa kan fidu ta'uu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: South Korea footballers urge safety after extreme heat statistics
english: South Korean professional football players are demanding better safety measures after a recent survey revealed that many have suffered from severe dehydration, dizziness, and even fainting due to extreme summer heat. With pitch temperatures surpassing 40 degrees Celsius, the players' union is calling for mandatory protocols, such as shifting kickoff times or canceling games during dangerous weather. While football authorities acknowledge these concerns and claim to prioritize athlete safety, they face logistical hurdles in updating schedules to fully meet the players' demands.

title: Israeli soldiers throw belongings from besieged Palestinian home
english: Israeli soldiers were captured on video discarding the personal items of Palestinian residents from their homes in the village of Qusra. This incident is part of a week-long siege imposed by Israeli settlers on several houses in the area. These actions highlight the ongoing cooperation between Israeli military forces and settlers during operations in the occupied West Bank.

title: Why are Hong Kong’s Tiananmen vigil organisers facing prison?
english: Two leading Hong Kong activists, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, have been convicted of inciting subversion under the national security law for their roles in organizing annual vigils for the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. The court ruled that the group’s slogans against the Chinese Communist Party undermined the state’s political system. The defendants, who have been detained since 2021, now face up to ten years in prison as part of a broader crackdown on political dissent in the region.

title: China rejects US claim that Myanmar analyst wrongfully detained
english: China has dismissed the US government’s claim that Myanmar-based scholar Min Zin, a US citizen, is being held unjustly. Chinese officials stated that Zin, who was arrested in June after being invited to a conference, is being detained for allegedly threatening national security. The US has officially designated the detention as wrongful, increasing diplomatic tensions shortly before a planned visit by President Xi Jinping to the White House.

title: 'Bloodline punishment': Iranian family faces ongoing punitive ICE detention
english: An Iranian-American family has been held in ICE detention for over four months due to the political history of the husband's mother during the 1979 Iran hostage crisis. Despite having no criminal records, the couple and their teenage son have been separated and denied the opportunity to leave the country voluntarily. Advocates argue that the government’s refusal to release them or allow their departure proves the detention is being used as a form of unjustified collective punishment.

title: How China eased pressure on oil markets by halting purchases and relying on reserves
english: Global oil markets have remained relatively stable despite the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, which disrupted a significant portion of worldwide supply. This stability is largely attributed to China's decision to use its strategic oil reserves instead of buying expensive fuel during the conflict. By avoiding purchases at inflated prices, China has prevented the extreme price spikes seen during past geopolitical crises.

title: 'He hates Palestine': West Ham urges fans to drop chant about Solomon's pro‑Israel stance
english: West Ham United has officially asked its fans to stop singing a derogatory chant directed at their new player, Manor Solomon. The club condemned the song, which targets Solomon's pro-Israel views, describing it as an offensive and divisive message that goes against the team's values. Solomon, a former Israeli soldier, has faced public backlash for his vocal support of Israel's military actions in Gaza.

title: Iran’s president calls for war to end ‘today’ from position of strength
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has advocated for an immediate end to ongoing conflicts while maintaining that his country remains in a strong and honorable position. He emphasized that recent diplomatic agreements were not a sign of surrender but a strategic success, insisting that Iran would not tolerate bullying. Despite seeking peace, he warned that the nation remains prepared to deliver a forceful response if attacked again.

title: Belgium condemns Israel’s E1 settlement expansion
english: Belgium and several other nations have formally criticized Israel's plan to build new settlements in the E1 area of the West Bank. These countries argue that the project is illegal and threatens the possibility of a two-state solution by physically splitting Palestinian territories. They warn that such construction will isolate East Jerusalem and prevent the development of a connected Palestinian state.

title: Panama Canal to cut number of ships passing through due to El Niño
english: The Panama Canal Authority is reducing daily vessel traffic from 36 to 32 ships starting in mid-September due to severe drought conditions linked to El Niño. This decision aims to conserve water resources for human use and ensure the canal remains operational during these dry weather patterns. As a vital global trade route, the canal faces these restrictions to maintain long-term sustainability while managing the impacts of climate change.

title: US allies in Asia wary as Trump moves military assets for Iran war
english: Asian allies are concerned as the United States shifts critical military resources, including its final aircraft carrier in the region, to the Middle East to support the ongoing war against Iran. This relocation, alongside the prior withdrawal of defense systems and ammunition, is raising fears that Washington’s ability to deter China's growing regional influence is weakening. Experts warn that these adjustments create a strategic vacuum while China continues to expand its naval presence near Taiwan and Japan.

english: China is currently expanding its robotics sector by developing advanced humanoid robots capable of human-like movement. title: Bayern Munich’s Musiala collapsed on-field as a result of medication change
english: Bayern Munich midfielder Jamal Musiala collapsed during two recent matches due to side effects from an adjustment in his medication for a known neurological condition. Musiala will miss the upcoming match against Borussia Dortmund to allow him time to recover and adjust.

title: Closure of al-Makha port leaves workers and traders fearing for the future
english: The al-Makha port in Yemen has suspended operations following a series of deadly drone and missile attacks by Houthi forces. This shutdown has left approximately 1,500 workers without their primary source of daily income, while traders are now facing increased costs to transport goods. With the local fishing industry also paralyzed by safety risks, many families in the region are struggling to meet their basic needs.

title: Who does the law serve in the occupied West Bank?
english: The article examines the complex and controversial legal framework currently governing the occupied West Bank. It questions whose interests are prioritized by the existing judicial and administrative systems in the region. The analysis highlights ongoing concerns regarding human rights and the unequal application of laws in these territories.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በአሁኑ ጊዜ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ላይ ተግባራዊ እየሆነ ያለውን ውስብስብና አወዛጋቢ የህግ ማዕቀፍ ይዳስሳል። በዚህ ክልል ውስጥ ባለው የፍትህና የአስተዳደር ስርዓት የማን ጥቅም እንደሚቀድም ይጠይቃል። ትንታኔው በሰብአዊ መብቶች እና በክልሉ ውስጥ ባሉ ህጎች ፍትሃዊ ባልሆነ አፈጻጸም ዙሪያ ያሉ ስጋቶችን ያነሳል።
oromo: Barruun kun seera yeroo ammaa kana lafa weeraramee jiru West Bank keessatti hojii irra jiru kan qoratu dha. Sirni haqaa fi bulchiinsaa naannichaa kun faayidaa eenyuu akka dursu gaaffii kaasa. Xiinxalli kun mirga namoomaa fi seera naannichatti haala walqixa hin taaneen hojii irra ooluu irratti yaaddoo jiru ibsa.

title: Charter plane crash near Alaskan military site kills 8
english: A chartered Cessna 441 plane crashed near a military radar station in western Alaska, resulting in the deaths of all eight people on board. The flight, operated by Security Aviation, went down on Thursday, and rescue teams confirmed there were no survivors at the scene. Authorities are currently investigating the incident and are in the process of notifying the families of the victims.
amharic: በምዕራብ አላስካ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ የራዳር ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ በተከሰከሰው ቻርተር አውሮፕላን ውስጥ የነበሩ ስምንቱም ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ሴኪዩሪቲ ኤቪዬሽን የተባለ ኩባንያ ያስተዳድረው የነበረው ሴስና 441 አውሮፕላን ሐሙስ ዕለት ተከስክሶ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች በቦታው ደርሰው ማንም እንዳልተረፈ አረጋግጠዋል። ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት የአደጋውን መንስኤ በመመርመር ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ የተጎጂዎችን ቤተሰቦች የማሳወቅ ስራ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Xiyyaarri charteerii tokko naannoo buufata raadaara waraana Itoophiyaa irraa fagoo argamu, baha Alaskaatti kukkunfeen namoonni saddeet lubbuun dabran. Xiyyaarri gosa Cessna 441 kan ta'e kun guyyaa Kamisaa kan kukkunfe yoo ta'u, gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa bakka sana ga'uun namni tokkollee ooluu dhabuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Abbootiin taayitaa balaa kana qorachaa jiran yoo ta'u, maatii namoota du'anii beeksisuuf hojjachaa jiru.

title: Russia says ready for ‘new ideas’ on Ukraine war that match Putin’s goals
english: A senior Russian official has stated that Moscow is open to new proposals for resolving the war in Ukraine, provided these ideas reflect Russia's military objectives and current territorial control. The Kremlin is looking for the United States to potentially resume its role as a mediator, although American diplomatic efforts have been largely sidelined by the conflict in Iran. President Putin maintains that any peace agreement must include Ukraine's demilitarization, neutrality regarding NATO, and the transfer of the Donbas region to Russian control.
amharic: የሩሲያ ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማት እንደገለጹት፣ ሀገራቸው በዩክሬን ያለውን ጦርነት ለመቋጨት የሚቀርቡ አዳዲስ ሃሳቦችን ለመቀበል ዝግጁ ነች፤ ነገር ግን ሃሳቦቹ የፕሬዚዳንት ፑቲንን ግቦች እና በምድር ላይ ያለውን ነባራዊ ሁኔታ መሰረት ያደረጉ መሆን አለባቸው። ሞስኮ አሜሪካ በመካከለኛነት ሚናዋ እንድትመለስ እንደምትፈልግ የጠቆመች ሲሆን፣ የአሜሪካ የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች በአሁኑ ወቅት በኢራን ጦርነት ምክንያት ተስተጓጉለዋል። ፑቲን በበኩላቸው ሰላም ለመፍጠር ዩክሬን የዶንባስን ክልል እንድትለቅ፣ ወታደራዊ አቅሟን እንድትቀንስ እና ወደ ኔቶ እንደማትቀላቀል ቃል እንድትገባ ይፈልጋሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Raashiyaa akka jedhanitti, waraana Yukreeniif furmaata argamsiisuu danda'u yaadota haaraa fudhachuuf qophiidha; ta'us yaadonnii kunniin kaayyoo Preezidaant Puutiin fi haala lafa irraa jiru kan calaqqisiisan ta'uu qabu. Raashiyaan Ameerikaan deebitee akka giddu-galeessa taatee waldhabdee kana furuuf carraaqqii gootu barbaaddi, garuu fedhiin Ameerikaa yeroo amanaa waraana Iraan irratti xiyyeeffateera. Preezidaant Puutiin, nagaa buusuuf Yukreen naannoo Donbaas akka gadhiiftu, humna waraanaa ishee akka hir'iftu fi mootummaa Naatoo (NATO) keessatti hirmaachuu akka dhiiftu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Iran promises to resist interference by foreign 'enemies' as Trump threatens new sanctions
english: Iran's parliament speaker, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, stated that Iran and Iraq will strengthen their ties to resist outside pressure and foreign interference. This follows threats from US President Donald Trump to impose severe new sanctions on Iran and any nations that support it. The US Treasury plans to intensify economic pressure to destabilize the Iranian government, while Iranian officials have condemned these measures as economic warfare that harms innocent civilians.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ ሞሐመድ ባgher ጋሊባፍ እንደተናገሩት፣ ኢራን እና ኢራቅ ከውጭ የሚመጣውን ተጽዕኖ ለመቋቋም ግንኙነታቸውን የበለጠ ያጠናክራሉ። ይህ አስተያየት የመጣው የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን እና ከእርሷ ጋር በሚሰሩ ሀገራት ላይ ከፍተኛ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥሉ ካስጠነቀቁ በኋላ ነው። የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር ኢራንን ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ውስጥ ለማስገባት ሲያቅድ፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግን እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች ንጹሃን ዜጎችን የሚጎዱ የኢኮኖሚ ሽብርተኝነት ድርጊቶች ናቸው በማለት ወቅሰዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Iran fi Iraaq dhiibbaa alaa ofirraa ittisuuf walitti dhufeenya isaanii cimsuuf akka hojjetan dubbataniiru. Kun kan ta'e erga pirezidaantiin Amerikaa Donald Trump Iran fi biyyoota ishee gargaaran hunda irratti guddina diinagdee cimaa qabu irratti qoqqobbiin jabaan akka itti fufu akeekkachiisanii boodadha. Mootummaan Amerikaa hoggansa Iran laaffisuuf dhiibbaa diinagdee dabaluu kan karoorfate yoo ta'u, qondaallonni Iran garuu tarkaanfiin kun namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa geessisuun 'shororkeessummaa diinagdee' dha jechuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Iranian oil prices rise as US blockade tightens supplies to China
english: The cost of Iranian oil has increased because American sanctions have successfully reduced the amount of fuel reaching Chinese markets. As supply chains tighten and fewer shipments arrive, buyers are now facing higher prices for the remaining available stock. With the threat of additional US sanctions against trade partners, the volume of exports from Iran continues to decline.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ የኢራን ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ወደ ቻይና እንዳይደርስ በመገደቡ የዋጋ ጭማሪ አስከትሏል። አቅርቦቱ በመቀነሱ ምክንያት ነዳጅ ገዥዎች ለቀሩት ክምችቶች የቀድሞውን ቅናሽ ማግኘት ቀርቶ ከፍተኛ ዋጋ እየከፈሉ ይገኛሉ። የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት በሚያደርጉ ሀገራት ላይ ተጨማሪ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥል በማስጠንቀቁ የኢራን የነዳጅ ኤክስፖርት መጠን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል።
oromo: Humni gama Ameerikaan cimaa dhufuun dhiyeessiin boba'aa Iraan gara Chaayinaa dhaqu hir'achuun gatii boba'ichaa dabalee jira. Dhiyeessiin gabaa irratti xiqqachuu irraa kan ka'e, bittoonni boba'aa gatii mi'aawaa kaffaluuf dirqamanii jiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyoota Iraan waliin daldalan irratti adabbii dabalataa akka fudhatu himuun isaa dhiibbaa gabaa kanaa caalaatti hammaachiisee jira.

title: Serie A: Key talking points heading into the new 2026-27 season
english: The 125th season of Serie A is set to begin with Inter Milan aiming to defend their title against strong competition from Juventus and AC Milan. While northern clubs continue to dominate the league, teams like Napoli and Roma are hoping to challenge for the top spots. The season is marked by significant roster changes across major clubs, including new coaching appointments and high-profile player transfers as teams struggle to restore Italy's prestige in European football.
amharic: የጣሊያን ሴሪ አ እግር ኳስ ሊግ 125ኛውን የውድድር ዘመን ሲጀምር፣ ኢንተር ሚላን የሊጉን ዋንጫ ለመከላከል ከጁቬንቱስ እና ከኤሲ ሚላን ከፍተኛ ፉክክር ይጠብቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን የሰሜን ጣሊያን ክለቦች በሊጉ የበላይነታቸውን ቢቀጥሉም፣ ናፖሊ እና ሮማ ዋንጫውን ለመውሰድ ዝግጅታቸውን አጠናቀዋል። በዚህ የውድድር ዘመን በርካታ ክለቦች አሰልጣኞቻቸውን በመቀየር እና አዳዲስ ተጫዋቾችን ወደ ቡድናቸው በማምጣት በአውሮፓ መድረክ የጣሊያንን ዝና ለመመለስ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Liigii kubbaa miilaa Xaaliyaanii Serie A bara dorgomminsaa 125ffaa isaa eegaluuf qophaa'aa jiru keessatti, Inter Milan qophii cimaa taasisee wancicha ittisuuf carraaqqii godha. Gareewwan akka Juventus fi AC Milan dorgommii cimaa ta'an kan eeggaman yoo ta'u, Napoli fi Roma garuu sadarkaa olaanaatti bahuuf abdii qabu. Yeroo ammaa kanatti gareewwan gurguddoon leenjistoota jijjiiruu fi taphattoota haaraa bituun sadarkaa biyyaalessaa fi Awurooppaa irratti milkaa'ina argachuuf carraaqqii guddaa taasisaa jiru.

title: Death of Syrian detainee sparks protest and conversation about prison reform
english: Mohammed Ghamira, a former White Helmets volunteer, died in Syrian police custody after suffering fatal injuries from an assault during his detention for a financial dispute. The government investigation confirmed that negligence and physical abuse caused the death of the 29-year-old, who suffered from a bleeding disorder. Protesters have taken to the streets to demand justice, signaling a shift in the country where citizens are now openly pushing for accountability for state misconduct.
amharic: የነጭ የራስ ቁር በጎ ፈቃደኛ የነበረው መሐመድ ጋሚራ በገንዘብ ክርክር ምክንያት በቁጥጥር ስር ውሎ በፖሊስ ጣቢያ በደረሰበት ድብደባ ህይወቱ አልፏል። መንግስት ባደረገው ምርመራ የፖሊስ ግድፈት እና ጥቃት ለወጣቱ ሞት ምክንያት መሆናቸው የተረጋገጠ ሲሆን ተጠያቂዎቹም ለህግ ቀርበዋል። በሶሪያ ህዝቡ ይህንን ግፍ በመቃወም በአደባባይ በመውጣት ፍትህን እየጠየቁ ሲሆን ይህም በአዲሱ የሶሪያ አስተዳደር የመንግስት ተቋማት ተጠያቂነትን ለመጠየቅ ያለውን ፍላጎት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Hojjetaa gargaarsaatiif beekamuu White Helmets kan ture Mohammed Ghamira, walitti buiinsa maallaqaa irratti darbatamee hidhamuun erga booda mana hidhaatti dararaa irra gahuun du'e. Qorannoon mootummaan gaggeesse akka mirkaneessetti, garmalee miidhamuu isaa fi du'a isaa kanaaf poolisiin itti gaafatamuu qaba, sababni isaas dhibee dhiigaa kan qabu ta'uu isaa utuu beekanii reebichi raawwatameera. Ummanni magaala Aleppo keessatti mormii dhageessisaa jiran kun, akkaataa biyyi sun sirna durii irraa gara gaafatamaa ta'etti cehuuf tattaaffii godhaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: How China eased pressure on oil markets by halting purchases and relying on reserves
english: Despite the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, global oil prices have remained relatively stable because China has significantly reduced its crude imports. Instead of buying expensive oil during the crisis, Beijing has relied on its massive strategic reserves and lowered domestic refining activity to conserve supply. This strategic buffer has prevented the kind of extreme price spikes seen in past geopolitical conflicts.
amharic: የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር መዘጋት ቢኖርም፣ ቻይና የነዳጅ ግዢዋን በእጅጉ በመቀነሷ የዓለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ በአንጻራዊ ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ ሆኖ ቆይቷል። ቤጂንግ በችግሩ ወቅት ውድ ነዳጅ ከመግዛት ይልቅ፣ ከፍተኛ ክምችት ላይ በመታመን እና የውስጥ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ሥራዋን በመቀነስ አቅርቦቷን ጠብቃለች። ይህ የቻይና ስትራቴጂያዊ እርምጃ በሌሎች ጊዜያት እንደታየው የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዳይወጣ አድርጓል።
oromo: Hanga'uun daandii bishanii Hormuz jiraatuus, Chaayinaan bittaa boba'aa ishee hir'isuun gabaan addunyaa akka hin raafamne gooteetti. Biyyattiin yeroo waraanaatti gatiin boba'aa dabaluun isaa dura, kuusaa ishee isa guddaa itti fayyadamuu fi hojii qulqulleessa boba'aa ishee gadi xiqqeessuun dhiyeessii ishee to'atteetti. tarsiimoon kun jijjiirama gatii boba'aa kan darbe keessatti mul'achaa ture akka hin mudanne ittiseera.

title: Nord Stream bombing suspect to Hollywood fixer: Who is Volodymyr Zhuravlev?
english: Croatian authorities have arrested Ukrainian diver Volodymyr Zhuravlev for his alleged role in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline sabotage. Interestingly, he was detained while working as a consultant on a Hollywood film project that dramatizes the very event he is accused of. Zhuravlev denies the allegations, and his legal team is currently fighting his extradition to Germany to face trial.
amharic: የክሮኤሺያ ባለስልጣናት እ.ኤ.አ. በ2022 የኖርድ ስትሪም ጋዝ መስመር ላይ ጥቃት አድርሰዋል ተብሎ የተጠረጠረውን ዩክሬናዊው ጠላቂ ቮሎዲሚር ዙራቭሌቭን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ተጠርጣሪው በቁጥጥር ስር የዋለው የተጠረጠረበትን ክስተት በሚተርክ የሆሊውድ ፊልም ስራ ላይ አማካሪ ሆኖ እየሰራ እያለ ነው። ዙራቭሌቭ ክሱን ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን ጠበቆቹም ለጀርመን እንዳይሰጥ በመታገል ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummoonni Kro’eeshiyaa lammii Yukreenii kan ta’e fi ogeessa daayivii Volodimiir Zhuuraavlev jedhamu, bara 2022 hidha gaazii Noord Stiriim irratti sabootaajii gaggeessuun shakkamee qabameera. Zhuuraavlev kan qabame, hojii fiilmii Hooliwuud kan taatee sabootaajii kanaa dubbatu irratti gorsaa ta’ee hojjechaa osoo jiruu dha. Inni yakka itti dhiyaate kana kan haale yoo ta’u, abukaatonni isaa gara Jarmanii akka hin ergamneef qabsoo seeraa gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Israeli settler kills Palestinian youth and wounds elderly man near Hebron
english: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians near Hebron in the West Bank, resulting in the death of a young man and leaving an elderly man seriously injured. During the same incident, the settlers reportedly set fire to a local building. Emergency medical teams arrived at the scene to provide aid before transporting the victims to the hospital.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ሄብሮን አቅራቢያ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በፈጸሙት ጥቃት አንድ ወጣት ሲገደል አንድ አረጋዊ ደግሞ በከባድ ሁኔታ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ ሰፋሪዎቹ በአካባቢው የሚገኝ አንድ ህንጻ ላይ እሳት ለኩሰዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ሰዎች ወደ ሆስፒታል በመውሰድ ህክምና እንዲያገኙ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Godina West Bank, magaalaa Hebron biratti gartuun Israa'el qubattee jiran haleellaa raawwataniin dargaggeessi tokko yoo du'u, jaarsi tokko ammoo miidhaa cimaa irra gahee jira. Haleellaa kanaan walqabatee, gartuun sun mana tokko irratti ibidda qabsiisanii jiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa bakka sanatti argamuun namoota miidhaman gara hospitaalaatti geessanii jiru.

title: Eight killed in plane crash at remote Alaskan military site, air force says
english: A civilian-contracted plane crashed near a remote US military radar site in Alaska, resulting in the deaths of all eight people on board. The aircraft had departed from Anchorage and was heading to Cape Newenham when the accident occurred. Authorities have launched an investigation into the cause of the crash, and the victims' identities will be released once their families have been notified.
amharic: በአላስካ በሚገኝ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ የራዳር ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ በተከሰተ የሲቪል አውሮፕላን አደጋ በውስጡ የነበሩት ስምንቱም ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አውሮፕላኑ ከአንኮሬጅ ተነስቶ ወደ ኬፕ ኒውሄም በመጓዝ ላይ እያለ ነበር አደጋው የደረሰው። ባለሥልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ የተጎጂዎቹ ማንነት ለቤተሰቦቻቸው ከተነገረ በኋላ ይፋ እንደሚደረግ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Alaskan keessatti xiyyaarri siivilii buufata raadaaraa waraana Ameerikaa tokko biratti kufuun isaa hordofee namoonni sagal keessa turan hundi lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Xiyyaarichi magaalaa Ankooreej irraa ka'ee gara Keep Niwunihaam imalaa utuu jiruu balaan kun mudate. Aangeyyoonni sababa balaa kanaa ilaalchisee qorannoo eegalanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, maqaan namoota du'anii maatiin isaanii erga beeksisamee booda ifa ta'a.

title: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan back in jail after hospital examination
english: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan has been returned to prison after medical professionals at an Islamabad hospital declared him healthy enough for incarceration. The hospital transfer was mandated by the Supreme Court following reports regarding Khan's declining health and limited vision. While the government claims he is fit, his legal team previously raised concerns about his lack of access to proper medical attention while in custody.
amharic: የቀድሞው የፓኪስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን በኢስላማባድ ሆስፒታል የህክምና ምርመራ ካደረጉ በኋላ ጤንነታቸው የተጠበቀ እንደሆነ በመገለጹ ወደ ወህኒ ቤት ተመልሰዋል። ይህ የህክምና ምርመራ የተካሄደው የፓኪስታን ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የካን የጤና ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ በመሆኑ በአስቸኳይ እንዲታዩ ባዘዘው መሠረት ነው። ምንም እንኳን መንግስት ካን ጤነኛ መሆናቸውን ቢገልጽም፣ የህግ ጠበቆቻቸው በወህኒ ቤት ውስጥ ተገቢውን የህክምና እርዳታ እያገኙ እንዳልሆነ ሲገልጹ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Paakistaan duraanii Imraan Kaan hospitaala Isilaamaabaad keessatti erga qorataman booda fayyaan isaanii gaarii ta'uun mirkanaa'ee gara mana hidhaatti deebifamaniiru. Murtii hospitaala geeffamuu kana kan dabarse mana murtii olaanaa yoo ta'u, kunis kan ta'e yaaddeffama fayyaa isaanii fi ija isaanii irratti dhiyaate hordofuudha. Mootummaan fayyaa isaanii gaarii akka ta'e ibsus, gorsiin isaanii garuu mana hidhaa keessatti yaala gahaa akka hin arganne himachaa turaniiru.

title: Philippines floods fuel anger over alleged corruption
english: Severe monsoon rains have caused extensive flooding in the northern Philippines, displacing many residents. In the aftermath, local citizens are expressing deep frustration and suspicion regarding potential corruption linked to flood-mitigation infrastructure projects. People are now calling for greater transparency and accountability from the government regarding these failed defenses.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል የጣለው ከባድ የዝናብ ወቅት ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ አስከትሎ በርካታ ነዋሪዎችን አፈናቅሏል። በዚሁ ወቅት ህዝቡ የጎርፍ መከላከያ ስራዎች ላይ ተፈጽሟል በተባለ ሙስና ምክንያት በባለስልጣናት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እያሰማ ነው። የሀገሪቱ ነዋሪዎች በመንግስት የጎርፍ መከላከያ ፕሮጀክቶች ላይ ግልጽ ምርመራ እና ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan torbanoota hedduuf roo'e kaaba Filippiinsitti balaa lolaa guddaa geessisee jira. Kanaan walqabatee, jiraattonni naannichaa hojiilee ittisa lolaa irratti harka qabaachuu danda'a jedhamuun shakkamee fi malaammaltummaa irratti mufannaa guddaa ibsachaa jiru. Namoonni miidhamanis mootummaan proojektiiwwan kanneen irratti qulqullinaa fi itti gaafatamummaa akka mirkaneessu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Cyclist Josh Tarling to compete in Tour of Spain after brother’s death
english: British cyclist Josh Tarling has decided to compete in the upcoming Tour of Spain, beginning just over a week after the tragic death of his brother, Finlay. Finlay, a 19-year-old cyclist, passed away following a collision with a vehicle during a race in Portugal. Despite this personal loss, Josh will participate in the event with the full support of his family and his team.
amharic: የብሪታኒያ ብስክሌተኛ ጆሽ ታርሊንግ ወንድሙ ፊንሌይ በአሳዛኝ ሁኔታ ካለፈ ከአንድ ሳምንት በኋላ በሚካሄደው የስፔን የብስክሌት ውድድር ላይ እንደሚሳተፍ ተገልጿል። የ19 ዓመቱ ፊንሌይ በፖርቱጋል በነበረው ውድድር ወቅት ከመኪና ጋር ተጋጭቶ ህይወቱ ማለፉ ይታወሳል። ጆሽ በቤተሰቡና በቡድኑ ሙሉ ድጋፍ በውድድሩ ላይ ለመካፈል ወስኗል።
oromo: Atileetiin biyya Ingiliz Josh Tarling obboleessi isaa Finlay erga du'ee torbee tokko booda, duula baaisikilii Ispeen irratti hirmaachuuf murteeffateera. Finlay, dargaggeessi waggaa 19, biyya Poorchugaal keessatti utuu baaisikilii oofuun jiruu konkolaataa waliin walitti bu'ee du'uun isaa ni yaadatama. Josh gadda guddaa kana keessa ta'us, maatii fi garee isaa waliin ta'uun duula kana irratti hirmaachuuf qophaa'eera.

title: Torrential rain floods New York City’s streets and subway
english: Heavy rainfall has triggered severe flash flooding throughout New York City. The deluge has submerged major roadways and caused water to pour into various subway stations. The city is currently dealing with significant travel disruptions due to the extreme weather conditions.
amharic: በኒውዮርክ ከተማ የጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ አስከትሏል። ጎርፉ ዋና ዋና የመንገድ ትራፊክ መስመሮችን ያጥለቀለቀ ሲሆን፣ በብዙ የምድር ባቡር ጣቢያዎች ውስጥም ውኃ ገብቷል። በዚህ አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት የከተማዋ የመጓጓዣ አገልግሎት ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan magaalaa Niiwyoorkiitti roobe lolaa tasaa hammaata ta'e uumeera. Lolaan kun daandiiwwan gurguddoo guutee kan jiru yoo ta'u, buufataaleen baaburaa baay'eenis bishaanin guutamaniiru. Haala qilleensa hamaa kanaan walqabatee, tajaajilli geejjiba magaalamtii sanaa miidhaa cimaa keessa galeera.

title: Swiatek into Cincinnati semis after Rybakina injury
english: Iga Swiatek advanced to the Cincinnati Open semifinals after her opponent, Elena Rybakina, withdrew early in the match due to a heel injury. This unexpected exit creates uncertainty regarding Rybakina’s participation in the upcoming US Open. Swiatek will next face Jessica Pegula, who secured her own spot in the semifinals following a hard-fought victory against Amanda Anisimova.
amharic: ኢጋ ስዋይቴክ ተጋጣሚዋ ኤሌና ሪባኪና በእግር ተረከዝ ጉዳት ምክንያት ከጨዋታው በመውጣቷ ወደ ሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን ግማሽ ፍፃሜ አልፋለች። ይህ ያልተጠበቀ መውጣት ሪባኪና በቅርቡ በሚጀምረው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ላይ ትሳተፍ እንደሆነ ጥርጣሬ ፈጥሯል። ስዋይቴክ በሚቀጥለው ዙር ከአማንዳ አኒሲሞቫን በማሸነፍ ወደ ግማሽ ፍፃሜ ያለፈችውን ጀሲካ ፔጉላን ትገጥማለች።
oromo: Iga Swiatek morkattuun ishee Elena Rybakina miidhaa qeensaa harka ishee mudateen taphicha addaan kuttee bahuu isheetiin gara semi-fayinaalii Cincinnati Open darbiteetti. Haalli kun Rybakina dorgommii US Open dhufuuf qophii ta'uu ishee irratti shakkii uumeera. Swiatek semi-fayinaalii irratti Jessica Pegula kan Amanda Anisimova injifatte waliin wal morkatti.

title: Poland summons Israeli ambassador over closed Gaza aid worker probe
english: Poland has officially summoned the Israeli ambassador to express dissatisfaction after Israel closed its investigation into an airstrike that killed seven aid workers, including a Polish volunteer. The Polish government criticized the decision to end the probe without accountability and is demanding further explanations. Meanwhile, Poland is continuing its own independent legal investigation into the 2024 attack on the charity convoy.
amharic: ፖላንድ በጋዛ ሰባት የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ ሰጪዎችን የገደለውን የአየር ጥቃት መርማሪ ቡድን እስራኤል መዝጋቷን ተከትሎ የአገሪቱን አምባሳደር በይፋ ጠርታለች። የፖላንድ መንግስት ጉዳዩን ተጠያቂነት በጎደለው መልኩ መዘጋቱን በመቃወም ማብራሪያ ጠይቋል። ዋርሶ ከዚህ ክስተት ጋር በተያያዘ የራሷን ገለልተኛ ምርመራ እያካሄደች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Polandiin duula qilleensa irraa kan ga’e fi hojjettoota gargaarsa namoomaa torba ajjeese ilaalchisee qorannoo Israa’el cufuusheetiin wal qabatee ambaasaaddara Israa’el waamtee jira. Mootummaan Poland murtee qorannoon kun osoo namni tokko itti hin gaafatamne cufamuu isaatti mormii isaa ibsee, ibsa dabalataa gaafachaa jira. Polandiin weerara bara 2024 raawwatame kana ilaalchisee qorannoo mataa ishee gaggeeffachaa jirti.

title: Canada condemns Israel for closing probe into aid worker killings
english: Canada has officially criticized Israel for ending its investigation into the deaths of seven humanitarian workers killed by airstrikes in Gaza last April. Among the victims was a Canadian national, leading officials to demand accountability and full justice for the affected families. The Canadian government emphasized that closing the case is unacceptable, especially given that the convoy had properly coordinated its travel with the military.
amharic: ካናዳ ባለፈው ሚያዝያ ወር በጋዛ ሰባት የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ሰራተኞችን ለገደለው የአየር ጥቃት እስራኤል ያደረገችውን ምርመራ መዝጋቷን አውግዛለች። ከተገደሉት መካከል የካናዳ ዜጋ በመገኘቱ፣ የካናዳ መንግስት ለሟች ቤተሰቦች ፍትህ እንዲሰጥና ጉዳዩ በግልጽ እንዲጣራ እየጠየቀ ይገኛል። አደጋው የደረሰው ተሽከርካሪዎቹ ከእስራኤል ወታደራዊ አካላት ጋር ተቀናጅተው በሚንቀሳቀሱበት ወቅት በመሆኑ፣ ጉዳዩን ምርመራ ሳያደርጉ መዝጋት ተቀባይነት እንደሌለው ካናዳ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Kanaadaan, baatii Ebla darbe naannoo Gaazaatti hojjettoota gargaarsa namoota torba ajjeese irratti Israa'el qorannoo ishee gabaabduu gochuu ishee balaaleffatteetti. Namoota du'an keessaa lammiin Kaanaadaa tokko waan jiruuf, mootummaan Kaanaadaa maatii miidhamtootaaf haqni akka argamuufi dhimmichi ifatti akka qoratamu gaafachaa jira. Konvooyichi waraana Israa'el waliin qindeeffatee socho'aa akka ture yaadachiisuun, qorannoo utuu hin gaggeessin dhimma kana cufuun fudhatama akka hin qabne ibsiteetti.

title: Meghan could return to acting once back in UK
english: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are reportedly planning a move back to the UK by the end of August, with their children set to start school there in September. Speculation has emerged that Meghan may resume her acting career, as reports suggest she has received a job offer for a project in Britain. Alongside potential acting work, she intends to focus on expanding her lifestyle brand, while the couple plans to settle into a private residence outside of London.
amharic: ልዑል ሃሪ እና ሜጋን ማርክ በነሐሴ ወር መጨረሻ ወደ እንግሊዝ እንደሚመለሱ እና ልጆቻቸውም በመስከረም ወር ትምህርት እንደሚጀምሩ ተዘግቧል። ሜጋን በእንግሊዝ አገር በአንድ ፕሮጀክት ላይ እንድትሳተፍ የቀረበላትን ጥሪ ተቀብላ ወደ ትወና ሥራዋ ልትመለስ እንደምትችል የሚጠቁሙ መረጃዎች ወጥተዋል። ባልና ሚስቱ ከለንደን ውጭ በግል መኖሪያ ቤት ለመኖር ያቀዱ ሲሆን፣ ሜጋን በትወና ሥራዋ ላይ ከመሳተፍ በተጨማሪ የአኗኗር ዘይቤ ብራንዷን በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ለማስፋፋት አቅዳለች።
oromo: Iji ijoollee mootii Haarii fi Meegan Maarkil dhuma baatii Agastii keessa gara biyya Ingilizii akka deebi'an fi ijoolleen isaanii immoo baatii Fulbaanaa keessa mana barumsaa akka jalqaban gabaafameera. Meegan biyyattii keessatti hojii fiilmii tokko irratti akka hirmaattu affeerraa waan argatteef gara hojii ishee duraanii kan ture tiyaatiraa ykn fiilmii hojjechuutti akka deebitu dubbatamaa jira. Qophiiwwan kanaan alatti, Meegan oomisha ishee kan ta'e kan jireenyaa (lifestyle brand) addunyaa irratti babal'isuuf kan karoorfatte yoo ta'u, isaanis gara fuulduraatti magaalattii London alatti mana dhuunfaa isaanii keessa jiraachuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Australia charges man for passing Ukrainian military intel to Russia
english: Australian authorities have arrested a 27-year-old dual citizen on charges of foreign interference. Police allege the man joined the Ukrainian military to gather sensitive information, which he then shared with people he believed were Russian intelligence agents. Officials stated that this betrayal endangered Ukrainian forces and emphasized that Australia will not tolerate activities that threaten national security.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ ባለስልጣናት በውጭ ሀገር ጣልቃ ገብነት ወንጀል የተጠረጠረ የ27 አመት የሁለት ዜግነት ባለቤት የሆነ ግለሰብን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ተጠርጣሪው የዩክሬን ወታደራዊ መረጃዎችን በመሰብሰብ ለሩሲያ የስለላ አካላት አሳልፎ እንደሰጠ ፖሊስ ይከሳል። ይህ ድርጊት የዩክሬን ወታደሮችን ህይወት ለአደጋ የዳረገ ሲሆን፣ አውስትራሊያ ሀገራዊ ደህንነትን የሚፈታተኑ ተግባራትን እንደማትታገስ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa lammii biyyattii fi Raashiyaa kan ta'e dargaggeessa umuriin isaa 27 ta'e tokko yakka farra-biyyummaan qabatee jira. Poolisiin akka ibsetti, namichi kun waraana Yukreen keessatti hirmaachuun odeeffannoo icitii waraanaa argate gara jilaa Raashiyaatti dabarsaa ture. Gochi kun humnoota Yukreen balaaf kan saaxile yoo ta'u, Awustiraaliyaan nageenya biyya ishee irratti rakkoo kan uuman kamiyyuu akka hin hayyamne hubachiise jira.

title: Sudan’s displacement crisis deepens as violence escalates
english: Sudan is facing a worsening humanitarian crisis as paramilitary forces continue to attack villages in the North Kordofan region. This surge in violence has forced thousands of families to abandon their homes and seek safety in the capital city of el-Obeid. Displaced people are now gathering in temporary camps as the regional conflict continues to displace civilian populations.
amharic: ሱዳን በሰሜን ኮርዶፋን ክልል በሚገኙ መንደሮች ላይ በታጣቂ ቡድኖች በሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ሳቢያ የከፋ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። ይህ እየተባባሰ የመጣ ግጭት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤተሰቦች መኖሪያቸውን ጥለው ወደ ኤል-ኦቤይድ ከተማ እንዲሸሹ አስገድዷቸዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ተፈናቃዮች ለጊዜያዊ መጠለያነት በተዘጋጁ ካምፖች ውስጥ ለመጠለል እየተገደዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Sudaan naannoo Kordofaan Kaabaa keessatti gareewwan hidhatan gandoota irratti haleellaa raawwachaa jiraniin walqabatee rakkoo namoomaa cimaa keessa seentetti. Walitti bu'iinsi kun maatiiwwan kumaan lakkaa'aman qe'ee isaanii gadi lakkisanii gara magaalaa El-Obeid akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Namoonni buqqa'an kunneenis walitti bu'iinsichi itti fufuu isaan booda qubattoota yeroo keessa qubachuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: Bangladesh expect ‘harder’ Australia challenge in second Test, says coach
english: Bangladesh cricket coach Phil Simmons has cautioned his team to prepare for a much tougher response from Australia in the upcoming second Test. This warning follows Bangladesh's historic first-ever Test victory against Australia in Darwin, which the local media described as a major upset. Despite the win, the coach expects the Australians to improve their performance significantly, though he is hesitant to change his successful lineup for the match in Mackay.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ የክሪኬት አሰልን ፊል ሲሞንስ ቡድናቸው በመጪው ሁለተኛ የሙከራ ጨዋታ (Test match) ከአውስትራሊያ ከባድ ፈተና እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው ባንግላዲሽ በዳርዊን በታሪክ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ አውስትራሊያን ካሸነፈች በኋላ ነው። አሰልጣኙ አውስትራሊያውያን አቋማቸውን እንደሚያሻሽሉ ቢጠብቁም፣ በአሸናፊነት የወጣውን የቡድን ስብስብ ለመቀየር ግን አልወሰኑም።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee kirikeetii Baangilaadish Phil Simmons gareen isaa tapha lammaffaa irratti Awustiraaliyaa irraa mormii cimaa akka eeggatu akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga Baangilaadish seenaa keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf Awustiraaliyaa mootee boodadha. Leenjisichi gareen Awustiraaliyaa akka fooyya’u kan eegu yoo ta’u, garee taphattoota isaa warra mo’atan jijjiiruuf garuu of eeggannoo godhaa jira.

title: Iran parliament chief visits graves of allied Iraqi fighters
english: The speaker of Iran's parliament, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, traveled to Iraq to honor the late leader of an Iran-supported militia, Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis. During his visit to the cemetery in Najaf, he also paid respects to other fallen members of regional armed groups. Al-Muhandis was previously killed alongside Iranian commander Qassem Soleimani in a 2020 American drone strike near Baghdad.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ኢራን ለምትደግፋቸው የኢራቅ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች መሪ ለአቡ መህዲ አል-ሙሀንዲስ ክብር ለመስጠት ኢራቅን ጎብኝተዋል። በናጃፍ ከተማ በሚገኘው መቃብር ስፍራ በመገኘት ለአል-ሙሀንዲስ እና ለሌሎች የተገደሉ የቡድኑ አባላት መታሰቢያ አድርገዋል። አል-ሙሀንዲስ በፈረንጆቹ 2020 በአሜሪካ ድሮን ጥቃት ከኢራኑ ጄኔራል ካሴም ሶሌይማኒ ጋር በባግዳድ መገደላቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyya iraan kan ta'an Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, hoogganaa garee hidhattoota iraan deggertu kan ta'an Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis kabajuuf gara biyya Iraaq imalaniiru. Magaala Naajaafitti argamuun, bakka awwalcha al-Muhandis fi miseensota garee hidhattootaa kanneen biroo daawwataniiru. Al-Muhandis bara 2020 haleellaa xiyyaara raadaaraa Ameerikaan ajaja Raayyaa iraan Qassem Soleimani waliin ajjeefamuun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Iran and Iraq will resist foreign interference, Ghalibaf says
english: Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that Iran and Iraq will remain united and reject any outside interference in their internal affairs. He emphasized that the two nations are bonded by shared history and religion, and they intend to work together to improve their regional security and economic development. By collaborating on joint projects, both countries aim to strengthen their independence and prevent foreign powers from influencing their futures.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ ጉባኤ መሀመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ኢራን እና ኢራቅ አንድነታቸውን በማጠናከር ማንኛውንም የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነት እንደሚቃወሙ አስታውቀዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት በጋራ ታሪክ እና ሃይማኖት የተሳሰሩ በመሆናቸው፣ የፀጥታ እና የኢኮኖሚ ትብብራቸውን በማሳደግ በጋራ እንደሚሰሩ ገልጸዋል። የጋራ ፕሮጀክቶችን በመተግበር የሁለቱን ሀገራት ነፃነት ማስጠበቅ እና የውጭ ኃይሎች በክልሉ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ መገደብ እንደሚያስፈልግ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran Mohammad Baager Gaalibaaf, biyyoonni Iran fi Iraaq walitti dhufeenya isaanii cimsuudhaan dhiibbaa biyyoota alaa kamiyyuu akka hin fudhanne ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni lamaan seenaa fi amantii waliin qooddataniin kan hidhata qaban ta’uu eeranii, nageenyaa fi guddina dinagdee isaanii waliin hojjechuuf murteessaniiru. Projeektiiwwan waliin hojjetan kanaan of-danda’anii jiraachuu fi dhiibbaa humnoonni alaa naannicharratti qaban hir’isuuf kan hojjetan ta’uu ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli army advances into southern Lebanese town, shelling reported
english: Israeli military vehicles have entered the southern Lebanese town of Khiam amidst intense shelling. Reports indicate that troops have destroyed a residential building within the town. Furthermore, artillery fire has been directed toward the outskirts of Mayfadoun.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪዎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በምትገኘው ኪያም ከተማ ውስጥ ገብተዋል። በከተማዋ ላይ ከባድ የቦምብ ድብደባ እየተካሄደ ሲሆን ወታደሮቹም አንድ መኖሪያ ቤት ማውደማቸው ተገልጿል። እንዲሁም በማይፋዶን አካባቢ ተጨማሪ የመድፍ ጥቃቶች መፈጸማቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el konkolaataa waraanaatiin gara magaalaa Khiyam kan kibba Libaanoositti argamtu seenaniiru. Magaalattii keessatti haleellaan meeshaa gurguddaan cimaan jiraachuun ibsamee, waraannis mana jireenyaa tokko barbadeessaniiru. Kana malees, naannawa Mayfaadoonitti haleellaan meeshaa waraanaa itti fufee jira.

title: Israeli settlers set fire to Palestinian home while family asleep
english: Israeli settlers recently set fire to a Palestinian home in the West Bank while a mother and her children were sleeping inside. This act of violence is part of a growing trend of attacks against Palestinians in the occupied territories. Human rights organizations are expressing deep concern that such incidents threaten the safety and survival of many local communities.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በምዕራብ ባንክ ውስጥ የምትገኝ አንዲት ፍልስጤማዊት እናት እና ልጆቿ ተኝተው እያሉ ቤታቸውን አቃጥለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በተያዙት ግዛቶች ውስጥ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እየተፈጸመ ካለው የጥቃት ማዕበል አንዱ ነው። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የብዙ የአካባቢው ማህበረሰቦችን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Warra Israa'el irraa dhufan kanneen naannoo weerarame irratti qubatan, mana maatii Paalastayinii tokko keessatti haatiifi ijoolleen osoo rafanii jiranu ibidda qabsiisaniiru. Gochi kun miidhaa fi doorsisa yeroodhaa gara yerootti naannoo kana keessatti Paalastayinii irratti raawwatamu keessaa isa tokko. Dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa, gochi akkasii kun jireenyaa fi nageenya hawaasa naannichaa baay'ee balaadhaaf saaxilaa akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: Europe, Canada condemn Israeli plans for new West Bank settlement
english: Several Western nations, including Canada and various European countries, have strongly criticized Israel's decision to move forward with plans for a major new settlement in the West Bank. This project, known as E1, is viewed as illegal and harmful because it would split the Palestinian territory in half and hinder future peace efforts. The international community, including the United Nations and Egypt, is calling for an immediate halt to these construction tenders to preserve the possibility of a contiguous Palestinian state.
amharic: ካናዳንና በርካታ የአውሮፓ ሀገራትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች የዓለም መንግስታት በእስራኤል የተያዘው ምዕራብ ባንክ ውስጥ አዲስ ሰፈራ ለመገንባት የተነደፈውን ዕቅድ አጥብቀው አውግዘዋል። ኢ-ወን የሚል ስያሜ የተሰጠው ይህ ግንባታ የፍልስጤምን መሬት ለሁለት በመክፈል ለሰላም ሂደት ትልቅ እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን ተገልጿል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትንና ግብፅን ጨምሮ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ይህንን ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት በአስቸኳይ እንዲያቆሙ እስራኤልን እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Kaanaadaa fi biyyoota Awurooppaa hedduun dabalatee, mootummoonni addunyaa garaa garaa karoora Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-Dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti manneen jireenyaa haaraa ijaaruuf qabatte cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Karoorri 'E-1' jedhamu kun lafa Falasxiin gargar kuta waan ta'eef, nagaa buusuuf yaaliin godhamu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'a jedhamee sodaatameera. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi biyyoonni akka Masrii dabalatee, sadarkaa addunyaatti qaamoleen fayyadamtoonni karoora kana yeroodhaan dhaabuun biyya Falasxiin tokko taatee akka itti fufu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
english: Israeli settlers have officially returned to the Kadim site in the occupied West Bank, twenty years after the area was abandoned. Supported by current government officials and far-right ministers, thirty families have moved back into the previously closed location near the city of Jenin. This move, which ignores international opposition, reverses a 2005 decision to dismantle the settlement and has caused significant concern among nearby Palestinian communities.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ከሃያ ዓመታት በኋላ በምዕራብ ባንክ ወደሚገኘው ካዲም ሰፈር በይፋ ተመልሰዋል። አሁን ባለው የእስራኤል መንግስት ድጋፍ፣ ሠላሳ ቤተሰቦች በጄኒን ከተማ አቅራቢያ ወደሚገኘው እና ቀደም ሲል የተዘጋው ቦታ ተመልሰዋል። ይህ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞን ችላ በማለት የተፈጸመው ድርጊት፣ እ.ኤ.አ በ2005 የተወሰደውን የሰፈራ ማፍረስ ውሳኔ የሚቀለብስ ሲሆን በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Warri qubattoota Israa'el waggoota digdamii booda naannoo Qadim kan iddoo qabatee jiru (West Bank) deebi'anii qubataniru. Mootummaan ammaa Israa'el deggarsa kennuun, maatiin soddoma ta'an magaalota Jeniin biratti iddoo kanaan dura cufame turetti deebi'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mormii idil-addunyaa kan tuffate fi murtoo bara 2005 godhamee ture kan jijjiire yoo ta'u, hawaasa Falasxiim naannichatti argaman biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Five missing after fire in Swiss Alpine town
english: A major fire destroyed a restaurant and its residential apartments in the Swiss town of Thusis early Friday morning. While fourteen people managed to escape the building, five others remain missing and eight individuals were hospitalized with various injuries. Authorities and firefighters were deployed immediately to handle the situation, and an investigation into the cause of the blaze is currently underway.
amharic: በስዊዘርላንድ ቱሲስ ከተማ ውስጥ በሚገኝ ምግብ ቤት እና መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ በደረሰ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ አምስት ሰዎች መጥፋታቸው ተሰምቷል። አስራ አራት ሰዎች ከህንጻው ማምለጥ የቻሉ ቢሆንም፣ ስምንት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች እና የፖሊስ ባለስልጣናት በቦታው ተገኝተው የእሳት አደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ እየጀመሩ ነው።
oromo: Magaalota Siwiizerlaandi kan taate Thusis keessatti balaan ibiddaa mana nyaataa fi mana jireenyaa tokko barbadeesseera. Namoonni kudha afur ta'an balaa kana jalaa miliquu danda'anis, namoonni shan amma ammaatti bakka buuteen isaanii hin beekamu akkasumas saddeet kan ta'an miidhaa irra ga'een hospitaala galaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa fi gareen dhaamsibda ibiddaa balaa kana to'achuuf ariitiin kan socho'an yoo ta'u, sababa balaa kanaa irratti qorannoon eegalameera.

title: Australian Hussey open to Ashes Test role as England make approach
english: Former Australian cricket star Mike Hussey has revealed he received an informal job offer to become the batting coach for the England Test team. The proposal came from England's new red-ball coach, Stephen Fleming, with whom Hussey previously worked in the Indian Premier League. While Hussey has not yet made a decision, he expressed that he is open to the possibility despite acknowledging it would feel strange to coach against his home country.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአውስትራሊያ የክሪኬት ኮከብ ማይክ ሀሲ የእንግሊዝ የቴስት ቡድን የባትቲንግ አሰልጣኝ እንዲሆን መጋበዙን አስታውቋል። ጥያቄው የመጣው ከእንግሊዝ አዲሱ የአሰልጣኝ ቡድን መሪ እስጢፋኖስ ፍሌሚንግ ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱም ቀደም ሲል በህንድ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ አብረው ሰርተዋል። ሀሲ እስካሁን የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ ባይወስንም፣ ለአገሩ አውስትራሊያ ተቃራኒ ሆኖ መስራት እንግዳ ቢመስለውም ዕድሉን ግን አልዘጋውም።
oromo: Leenjisaan tapha Kirikeetii durii kan Awustiraaliyaa Mike Hussey, garee biyya Ingilizii leenjisuuf waamicha afaanin godhameef fudhachuu isaa ibseera. Waamichi kun kan dhufe leenjisaa haaraa Ingilizii Stephen Fleming irraa yoo ta'u, isaanis kanaan dura liigii Kirikeetii Indiyaa irratti waliin hojjetaniiru. Hussey hamma ammaatti murtoo dhumaa kan hin goone ta'us, biyya isaa Awustiraaliyaa irratti leenjisuun isatti xaxamaa ta'us carraa kana akka hin cufne dubbateera.

title: Dr TikTok: Mental health moves from consulting rooms to social media
english: Mental health information and advice from professionals are becoming highly popular on social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram. While this content helps bridge gaps caused by professional shortages and reduces stigma, experts warn that it cannot substitute for formal medical treatment. Users are encouraged to view these digital resources as supplementary rather than as a replacement for clinical care.
amharic: የአእምሮ ጤና መረጃዎች እና ምክሮች እንደ ቲክቶክ እና ኢንስታግራም ባሉ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መድረኮች ላይ በስፋት እየተሰራጩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ሁኔታ በባለሙያዎች እጥረት ምክንያት የሚፈጠረውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት እና ግንዛቤን ለመጨመር የሚረዳ ቢሆንም፣ ባለሙያዎች እንደሚያስጠነቅቁት ኦፊሴላዊ የሕክምና እርዳታን ሊተካ አይችልም። ተጠቃሚዎች እነዚህን ዲጂታል መረጃዎች እንደ ተጨማሪ መረጃ እንጂ እንደ ሙሉ የሕክምና አማራጭ ሊወስዷቸው አይገባም።
oromo: Odeeffannoowwan fayyaa sammuu fi gorsi ogeeyyotaan kennamu miidiyaalee hawaasummaa akka TikTok fi Instagram irratti baay'inaan babaldhachaa jira. Kunis hanqina ogeeyyotaa guutuufi hubannoo dabaluuf kan gargaaru ta'us, ogeeyyiin akka akeekkachiisanitti tajaajila fayyaa idilee bakka bu'uu hin danda'u. Fayyadamtoonni odeeffannoowwan dijitaalaa kana akka gargaarsa dabalataatti malee, akka bakka buutuu wal'aansa kilinikaatti fudhachuu hin qaban.

title: ‘Very unusual’: UK Palestine activists could be sentenced as terrorists
english: Five activists in the UK are facing the possibility of being sentenced under terrorism laws after causing significant property damage to a Barclays bank branch in 2024. The group protested the bank's financial ties to an Israeli defense firm, but their legal team argues that applying terrorism-related sentencing is highly irregular since the group was not banned at the time of the incident. A court is expected to decide soon whether these charges will be officially applied to their upcoming September sentencing.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም አምስት አክቲቪስቶች እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 በባርክሌይስ ባንክ ቅርንጫፍ ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሳቸው በአሸባሪነት ህግ ሊቀጡ እንደሚችሉ ተገልጿል። ተከሳሾቹ ባንኩ ከእስራኤል የመከላከያ ኩባንያ ጋር ያለውን የገንዘብ ግንኙነት በመቃወም ያደረጉት ድርጊት አሸባሪነትን እንደማያካትት ጠበቆቻቸው ይከራከራሉ። ፍርድ ቤቱ እነዚህ ተከሳሾች በሴፕቴምበር ወር በሚሰጠው ብያኔ በአሸባሪነት ህግ እንዲቀጡ መደረግ አለመደረጉን በቅርቡ ይወስናል።
oromo: UK keessatti namoonni shanan tokko bara 2024 damee baankii Barclays irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiisaniin walqabatee seera shororkeessummaan himatamuu danda'u. Gareen kun baankichi dhaabbata ittisa Israa'el waliin walitti dhufeenya qabu mormuuf tarkaanfii fudhatanus, gorsitoonni seeraa isaanii seeronni shororkeessummaa akkasitti hojiirra ooluun isaa haaraa fi sirrii akka hin taane dubbatu. Manni murtii adabbii isaanii kan waxabajjii irratti murteessuuf karoorfamee jiru, himannaan shororkeessummaa kun irratti akka itti fufu ykn hin fufne murteessuuf jira.

title: Malaysia denounces Israel's E1 settlement expansion in occupied West Bank
english: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has strongly condemned Israel's plan to expand the E1 settlement project in the West Bank. He warned that this development would split the territory and severely damage efforts to establish a future Palestinian state. Furthermore, Malaysia stated it will monitor companies involved in these projects and emphasized its ongoing support for Palestinian sovereignty.
amharic: የማሌዢያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዋር ኢብራሂም እስራኤል በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የኢ-1 ሰፈራ ፕሮጀክትን ለማስፋፋት የወሰደችውን እርምጃ በብርቱ አውግዘዋል። ይህ የግንባታ እቅድ የዌስት ባንክን በመከፋፈል የወደፊቱን የፍልስጤም መንግሥት የመመስረት ተስፋ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደሚያደርስ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ማሌዢያም በእነዚህ የግንባታ ስራዎች ላይ የሚሳተፉ ኩባንያዎችን እንደምትከታተል በመግለጽ ለፍልስጤም ሉዓላዊነት ያላትን ድጋፍ ደግማ አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Maleeziyaa Anwaar Ibraahim, Israa'el naannoo weeraramee kan ta'e 'West Bank' keessatti pirojektii mana jireenyaa E1 babal'isuuf karoorfattetti mormii cimaa ibsaniiru. Ijaarsi kun lafa 'West Bank' bakka lamatti hiruu fi hundeeffama mootummaa Filisxeem gara fuulduraa irratti miidhaa cimaa akka geessisu akeekkachiisaniiru. Maleeziyaan pirojektii kana irratti kan hirmaatan dhaabbilee gara garaa akka hordoftu fi deggerree isaanii kan Filisxeemif qaban itti fufuun ibsameera.

title: Israeli shelling in Syrian Golan Height's sparks fire
english: Israeli artillery fire recently targeted agricultural land near the Syrian village of Jubata al-Khashab in the Golan Heights. The shelling, which included the use of illumination flares, caused a fire to break out on the farmland. State media reports confirmed the incident occurred in the southern part of the village.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያዎች በጎላን ኮረብታ በምትገኘው የጁባታ አል-ካሻብ መንደር አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ እርሻ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ይህ ድብደባ እና የመብራት ቦምቦች መተኮስ በእርሻ መሬቱ ላይ የእሳት አደጋ እንዲነሳ አድርጓል። የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን እንደዘገቡት ከሆነ ክስተቱ የተከሰተው በመንደሩ ደቡባዊ ክፍል ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el naannoo Golan Heightsitti argamtu gandoota Jubata al-Khashab jedhamu biratti lafa qonnaa irratti dhukaasa bananii turan. Dhukaasni kun ibiddoota ifa kennan waliin walqabatee lafa qonnaa sana irratti ibidda kaasee jira. Gabaasni miidiyaalee mootummaa akka ibsetti, miidhaan kun kan ga'e gammoojjii ganda sanaa gara kibbaatti argamu irratti dha.

title: JD Vance says US economic pressure 'most effective tool' against war on Iran
english: US Vice President JD Vance announced that the government is prioritizing economic sanctions as its primary strategy against Iran. He explained that this approach aims to increase American energy production, which would help lower fuel costs for citizens. The administration intends to maintain this strategy as the most impactful way to exert international pressure.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምትከተለው ዋና ስልት ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ማሳደር እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ አካሄድ የአሜሪካን የነዳጅ ምርት በመጨመር የሀገር ውስጥ የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ እንደሚያግዝ አስረድተዋል። መንግስታቸው ይህንን የጫና ስልት እንደ ውጤታማ መንገድ አድርጎ እንደሚቀጥልበትም አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa diinagdee fayyadamuun imaammata ijoo Itoophiyaa irratti hordofaa jirtu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun omisha boba'aa Ameerikaa dabaluun gatii boba'aa biyyattii gadi buusuuf gargaara jedhamee amanama. Mootummaan isaanii dhiibbaa diinagdee kana akka meeshaa cimaa tokkootti fayyadamuuf akka itti fufan ibsaniiru.

title: Ongoing Israeli air strikes, massive blasts reported in south Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces launched a series of air strikes and artillery attacks across several locations in southern Lebanon early Friday. Significant explosions were reported in the town of Mansouri, with additional military activity observed in areas including Ali al-Taher Hill, Haddatha, and Tayri. These strikes have caused widespread concern throughout the southern region as the conflict continues to intensify.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች አርብ እለት በሊባኖስ ደቡባዊ አካባቢዎች ተከታታይ የአየር እና የመድፍ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። በማንሱሪ ከተማ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች የተሰሙ ሲሆን በአሊ አል-ታሂር ኮረብታ እንዲሁም በሐዳታ እና በታይሪ ከተሞችም ተመሳሳይ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ታይተዋል። ይህ የቀጠለው ጥቃት በክልሉ ከፍተኛ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን ውጥረቱ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganamuma Jimaataa kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa qilleensaa fi meeshaa gurguddaan bananiiru. Magaala Mansuurii keessatti dhoohaan cimaan dhaga'ameera; akkasumas gaara Ali al-Taahiri fi magaalota Haddatha fi Tayri irratti haleellaan raawwatameera. Haleellaan kun naannichatti soda guddaa uumee kan jiru yoo ta'u, waldhibdeen kunis caalaatti hammaachaa jira.

title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian man during raid in Jenin
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid in Jenin that resulted in the death of a Palestinian man named Fathi Khazem. While local health officials reported he was killed inside his residence, Israeli media claimed the shooting occurred after he allegedly tried to attack soldiers. The incident took place during an attempted arrest operation in the al-Masarwa neighborhood.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በጀኒን ባደረጉት ዘመቻ ፋቲ ካዘም የተባለ ፍልስጤማዊ ግለሰብ ተገድሏል። የጤና ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ግለሰቡ የተገደለው መኖሪያ ቤቱ ውስጥ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ሚዲያዎች ግን ወታደሮቹን በቢላ ለመውጋት ሲሞክር እንደተገደለ ይናገራሉ። ክስተቱ የተፈጠረው ወታደሮቹ በጀኒን ከተማ ውስጥ በታቀደላቸው የመያዝ ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el magaalaa Jeniin keessatti tarkaanfii fudhateen Fathi Kaazem jedhamu ajjeefameera. Maddi oduu fayyaa akka ibsetti namichi kun mana isaa keessatti kan ajjeefame yoo ta'u, miidiyaaleen Israa'el garuu loltoota waraanaaf harka kennuu diduun miilaan waraana irratti yaale kan ajjeefame ta'uu gabaasaniiru. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo waraanni sun nama kana qabuuf yaalii godhaa turetti dha.

title: British rapper Yung Filly to face retrial on rape charges in Australia
english: British rapper and YouTuber Yung Filly, whose real name is Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos, will face a retrial in Australia regarding three rape charges. Although a jury acquitted him of several sexual assault and violence-related offenses, they failed to reach a unanimous verdict on these specific counts. The entertainer, who was already convicted of two assault charges involving bodily harm, is scheduled to appear in court again in August.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ራፐር እና የዩቲዩብ ተጠቃሚ ያንግ ፊሊ፣ ትክክለኛ ስሙ አንድሬስ ፌሊፔ ቫለንሲያ ባሪየንቶስ፣ በአውስትራሊያ በሶስት አስገድዶ መድፈር ክሶች ላይ እንደገና ችሎት ይቀርባል። ዳኞች ከበርካታ የወሲብ ጥቃት ክሶች ነፃ ቢለቁትም፣ በተጠቀሱት ሶስት ክሶች ላይ ግን መግባባት ላይ መድረስ አልቻሉም። ቀደም ሲል በሁለት የአካል ጉዳት ጥቃት ክሶች ጥፋተኛ የተባለው ይህ ታዋቂ ሰው፣ በነሐሴ ወር እንደገና ፍርድ ቤት ይቀርባል።
oromo: Raapparriifi YouTuber-ri biyya Ingiliz Yung Filly, maqaan isaa dhugaan Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos jedhamu, himannaa gudeeddii sadii irratti dhiyaateef Awustiraaliyaatti irra deebi'ee mana murii dhiyaachuuf jira. Koreen murteessituu himannaa miidhaa saalaa hedduu irraa isa bilisa baasaniis, himannaa gudeeddii sadii irratti garuu waliigaltee irra gahuu hin dandeenye. Namni beekamaan kun kanaan dura himannaa miidhaa qaamaa lama irratti yakka qabaachuu isaa erga mirkanaa'ee booda, gara fuulduraatti gaafa Hagayyaa ammas mana murii dhiyaachuuf jira.

title: Dozens of migrants land on Spanish coast surprising beachgoers
english: A group of 62 migrants unexpectedly arrived at Cala Del Barco beach in southeastern Spain by boat, startling people who were relaxing on the shore. Spanish authorities and the Civil Guard were alerted to the situation and successfully located all the individuals involved. Social media footage captured the unusual scene as the boat landed among the beachgoers.
amharic: 62 ስደተኞች በጀልባ በደቡብ ምስራቅ ስፔን ወደምትገኝ የባህር ዳርቻ በመድረሳቸው በቦታው የነበሩትን ሰዎች አስደንግጠዋል። የስፔን ባለስልጣናት እና የሲቪል ጥበቃ ሰራዊት ስደተኞቹ መድረሳቸውን ተከትሎ በፍጥነት በመንቀሳቀስ በሙሉ ቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋቸዋል። ክስተቱ የተከሰተው ካላ ደል ባርኮ በተባለ የባህር ዳርቻ ሲሆን፣ በወቅቱ በቦታው የነበሩ ሰዎች ሁኔታውን በምስል ቀርጸው በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ አሰራጭተውታል።
oromo: Godantoonni 62 ta’an doonii xiqqoon gara qarqara galaana Cala Del Barco kan kibba-baha Ispeenitti argamu dhaqqabuun namoota bakka sana bashannana turan dinqisiiseera. Aangeyyoonni biyyattii fi poolisiin nageenyaa battalatti sadarkaa sana irra ga’uun godantoota hunda to’annoo jala oolchaniiru. Namoonni qarqara galaanichatti turan haala tasa mudate kana viidiyoon waraabuun miidiyaalee hawaasummaa irratti qoodaniiru.

title: Hong Kong Tiananmen activists found guilty of national security charges
english: Two prominent Hong Kong activists, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, have been convicted of inciting subversion for organizing annual vigils commemorating the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. The court proceedings are being criticized by rights groups as an example of declining freedom of speech in the region under strict national security laws. The pair now face potential prison sentences of up to ten years as authorities continue to suppress public memory of the historical event.
amharic: ሁለት ታዋቂ የሆንግ ኮንግ አክቲቪስቶች የሆኑት ሊ ቼኡክ-ያን እና ቾው ሃንግ-ቱንግ፣ በ1989 የተካሄደውን የቲያንሜን አደባባይ ጭፍጨፋ ለማስታወስ የሻማ ማብራት ስነ-ስርዓት በማዘጋጀታቸው መንግስትን በመፈንቀል ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ሆነዋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ይህ ፍርድ በሆንግ ኮንግ የመናገር ነፃነት እየተገደበ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሁለቱ አክቲቪስቶች እስከ አስር ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊፈረድባቸው እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mirga namoomaa Hong Kong Lee Cheuk-yan fi Chow Hang-tung jedhaman, yaadannoo ajjeechaa bara 1989 naannoo Tiyaananmen qopheessuun isaaniif himata mootummaa fonqolchuun yakka irratti itti murtaa'eera. Murtii kanaan walqabatee gareewwan mirga namoomaa, Hong Kong keessatti mirgi yaada ibsachuu akka xiqqaachaa deeme dubbachuun balaaleeffataniiru. Namoonni kunneen amma hidha waggaa kudhanii gahuu danda'u.

title: Hamas told to be 'sensitive' to Netanyahu ahead of Israeli elections as attacks on Gaza continue
english: A senior Hamas official revealed that mediators requested the group exercise caution regarding Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political position ahead of upcoming elections. Hamas rejected this pressure, stating they are not willing to sacrifice Palestinian lives to help Netanyahu secure a political victory. Meanwhile, the group emphasized that Israel has failed to uphold its ceasefire commitments while continuing military strikes and restricting aid into Gaza.
amharic: የሃማስ ከፍተኛ አመራር እንደገለጹት አሸማጋዮች በእስራኤል ምርጫ ወቅት ለጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ጠይቀዋቸዋል። ሃማስ ይህን ጥያቄ ውድቅ በማድረግ የኔታንያሁ የፖለቲካ ድል እውን እንዲሆን የፍልስጤማውያንን ህይወት ለመሰዋት ፈቃደኛ እንዳልሆነ አስታውቋል። በሌላ በኩል ሃማስ እስራኤል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን ባለማክበር በጋዛ ላይ ጥቃቷን እንደቀጠለችና ሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንዳይገባ እያደረገች መሆኗን ገልጿል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoo Haamaas akka jedhanitti, giddu-galaan dubbattoonni filannoo Israa'el dura dhimma siyaasaa muummicha ministeeraa Benyaamiin Netanyaahuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennuuf isaan gaafatanii turan. Haamaas dhiibbaa kana mormuudhaan, injifannoo siyaasaa Netanyaahuuf jecha jireenya Ummata Falasxeen aarsaa gochuuf fedhii akka hin qabne ibseera. Gama biraatiin, Israa'el waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa cabsuudhaan Gaazaa irratti haleellaa itti fufuu fi gargaarsa namoomaa daangessuu ishee Haamaas himateera.

title: El Niño set to be 'strongest in living memory', says Met Office
english: The UK Met Office warns that a developing El Niño event in the Pacific is likely to become the most powerful one ever recorded. This intense natural weather pattern, combined with human-caused climate change, is expected to make 2027 the hottest year in history. The phenomenon is already disrupting global weather, causing unpredictable rainfall and storm patterns worldwide.
amharic: የብሪታንያ ሜትሮሎጂ ቢሮ በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ እየተከሰተ ያለው የኤል নিনዮ ክስተት በታሪክ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ ኃይል እንደሚኖረው አስጠንቅቋል። ይህ ተፈጥሯዊ የአየር ሁኔታ ለውጥ ከሰው ሰራሽ የአየር ንብረት መዛባት ጋር ተዳምሮ፣ ዓመተ ምህረት 2027 በዓለም ታሪክ እጅግ ሞቃታማው ዓመት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተገምቷል። ይህ ክስተት በአሁኑ ወቅት በዓለም ዙሪያ ባሉ የዝናብ እና የአየር ሁኔታ ዑደቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል እየፈጠረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Biroon qilleensa UK akka akeekkachiisetti, mudannoon El Nino Paasifikii keessatti uumamaa jiru kun hanga har'aatti kan mul'ate keessaa kan hunda caalu ta'uuf deema. Jijjiiramni qilleensaa kun kan namaan dhufu waliin walitti makamee, bara 2027 waggaa addunyaa irratti hunda caalaa ho'aa ta'u akka danda'u ibsameera. Mudannoon kun amma iyyuu qilleensa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jiruun, roobaa fi bubbee irratti jijjiirama hin baratamne fidaa jira.

title: Why the US economy is ringing alarm bells
english: The United States national debt has officially surpassed $40 trillion, a significant milestone that has raised concerns among economists and policymakers. This rapid growth is fueled by years of high public spending, tax cuts, and the need to fund pandemic and financial crisis recovery efforts. With interest rates currently at multi-decade highs, the cost of servicing this massive debt is becoming increasingly expensive and unsustainable for the government.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ብሄራዊ ዕዳ ከ40 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ በማለፉ በኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ይህ ዕዳ በፍጥነት እንዲያድግ ያደረጉት የመንግስት የወጪ ጭማሪዎች፣ የግብር ቅነሳዎች እና ለተለያዩ ቀውሶች ምላሽ ለመስጠት የተወሰዱ ብድሮች ናቸው። በአሁኑ ወቅት የወለድ ምጣኔ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ በመሆኑ፣ ይህንን ግዙፍ ዕዳ ለመክፈል የሚወጣው ወጪ ለመንግስት ፈተና እየሆነ መጥቷል።
oromo: Hanga idaa biyyoolessaa kan Ameerikaa tilmaama tiriliyoona 40 ga'ee jiraachuun isaa hayyoota dinagdee biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira. Daballiin idaa kanaa kan dhufe waggoota darban keessa baasii mootummaan baase, hir'ina gibiraa fi furmaata rakkoolee diinagdee addunyaa irratti hunda ta'uun isaati. Yeroo ammaa qoodni dhala baankii (interest rate) sadarkaa olaanaa irra waan jiruuf, idaa kana kaffaluun mootummaa irratti ba'aa guddaa ta'ee jira.

title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists guilty in national security trial
english: Two Hong Kong activists, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, have been convicted of subverting state power for organizing vigils commemorating the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. The pair faces up to 10 years in prison under the city's strict national security law, which has been used to silence dissent and stop public memorial gatherings. Rights groups have criticized the verdict, arguing that the activists are being unfairly targeted for peaceful actions that do not constitute legitimate crimes.
amharic: የሆንግ ኮንግ አክቲቪስቶች የሆኑት ሊ ቼክ-ያን እና ቾው ሃንግ-ቱንግ፣ የ1989 የቲያናንመን አደባባይ ግድያን የሚዘክር የሻማ ማብራት ስነ-ስርዓት በማዘጋጀታቸው በመንግስት ስልጣን ላይ ሴራ በመጠቅለል ወንጀል ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች በከተማዋ ተግባራዊ በሆነው ጥብቅ የብሔራዊ ደህንነት ህግ እስከ 10 ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊቀጡ ይችላሉ። ዓለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች ይህ ውሳኔ ፍትሃዊ አይደለም በማለት የሁለቱንም አክቲቪስቶች በአስቸኳይ እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mirga namoomaa Hong Kong kan ta'an Lee Cheuk-yan fi Chow Hang-tung, yaadannoo guyyaa ajjeechaa dirree Tiananmen bara 1989 qopheessuudhaan mootummaa fonqolchuuf yaalan jechuudhaan itti murteeffameera. Namoonni kunneen seerri nageenya biyyaalessaa kan Hong Kong akka jedhutti waggaa 10 hamma ta'uuf hidhamuu danda'u. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa fi namoonni hedduun murtoon kun kanneen yaada isaanii ibsatan irratti uggura kaa'uuf kan fudhatame akka ta'e ibsuun, namoonni kunneen akka gadhiifaman gaafataniiru.

title: Pakistan’s Imran Khan moved to hospital after Supreme Court order
english: Pakistan's former Prime Minister Imran Khan has been transferred from prison to a private medical facility. This move follows a direct intervention and order from the country's Supreme Court. Mr. Khan has been serving a jail sentence for over three years.
amharic: የፓኪስታኑ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን ከእስር ቤት ወደ ግል የህክምና ማዕከል ተዛውረዋል። ይህ የተደረገው የሀገሪቱ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ባስተላለፈው ትእዛዝ መሰረት ነው። የ73 ዓመቱ ኢምራን ካን ከሶስት ዓመታት በላይ በእስር ላይ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Paakistaan duraanii Imraan Khaan mana hidhaatii gara hospitaala dhuunfaatti darbeera. Jijjiirraan kun kan raawwatame ajaja Mana Murtii Olaanaa biyyattii hordofee dha. Khaan waggoota sadii ol mana hidhaatti erga darbatamanii booda yaalama jiru.

title: Poland summons Israeli envoy over dropped probe into killing of WCK aid workers
english: The Polish government has officially summoned the Israeli ambassador to express its strong dissatisfaction after Israel closed its investigation into an airstrike that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers, including a Polish citizen. Warsaw condemned the decision to drop the probe and is demanding a full explanation regarding the tragedy. Polish officials emphasized that they will not tolerate efforts by those responsible to avoid legal and moral consequences for the deaths.
amharic: የፖላንድ መንግሥት የዓለም የምግብ ማዕከል ሰራተኞችን ገድሏል የተባለውን የአየር ጥቃት መርማሪ ቡድን እስራኤል መዝጋቷን ተከትሎ የእስራኤልን አምባሳደር በይፋ ጠርቷል። በፖላንድ ዜጋ ላይ ደረሰውን ጉዳት ጨምሮ ሰባት የሰብዓዊ ዕርዳታ ሰራተኞች ለተገደሉበት ክስተት እስራኤል የወሰደችውን ውሳኔ ዋርሶ በጽኑ አውግዛለች። የፖላንድ መንግሥት የሟቾች ጉዳይ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲጣራ እና ተጠያቂዎች ከሕግና ከሞራል ግዴታቸው ለማምለጥ የሚያደርጉትን ሙከራ እንደማይቀበሉ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Pooland gareen qorannoo Israa’el balaa xiyyaaraa hojjettoota dhaabbata gargaarsa 'World Central Kitchen' torba ajjeese irratti gaggeessaa ture cufuusaa mormuun, ambaasaaddara Israa'el waamuu ishee beeksisite. Pooland du'a lammii ishee dabalatee namoota gargaarsa namoomaa irratti argaman kana irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatame akka sirritti qoratamu gaafatteetti. Mootummaan Pooland qondaaltoonni kun itti gaafatamummaa seeraa fi amala irraa akka hin miliqne akeekkachiisuun, dhimmi kun hamma dhumaatti akka qulqullaa’u gaafatteetti.

title: Bali jails Swiss tourist for insulting sacred Day of Silence
english: A Swiss tourist has been sentenced to one year in prison for breaking rules during Bali’s sacred Day of Silence, known as Nyepi. The 26-year-old was arrested after posting an offensive video of himself walking on a beach during the holiday, which requires everyone on the island to remain indoors and quiet. While the tourist apologized and claimed he did not understand the severity of the restrictions, authorities used the sentence to emphasize the importance of respecting local customs.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ባሊ ደሴት አንድ የስዊስ ቱሪስት በቅዱሱ የዝምታ ቀን ወይም 'ኒዬፒ' ወቅት ህግ በመተላለፉ የአንድ ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። የ26 ዓመቱ ወጣት በበዓሉ ቀን ከቤት መውጣት ክልክል ቢሆንም፣ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ሲንቀሳቀስ የሚያሳይ አሳፋሪ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመልቀቁ ነበር የታሰረው። ቱሪስቱ ድርጊቱን በመጸጸት ይቅርታ ቢጠይቅም፣ የባሊ ባለስልጣናት የአካባቢውን ባህልና ሃይማኖታዊ ክንውኖች ለማክበር ጥብቅ እርምጃ መውሰዳቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Turistiin biyya Swiizerlaand tokko guyyaa soomanaa fi calliinsa Bali ykn 'Nyepi' jedhamu kan kabajamu keessatti seera cabsee argamuun hidhaa waggaa tokkoon adabameera. Namni umuriin isaa 26 ta'e kun guyyaa sana namni hundi manatti taa'ee calliinsaan turuun dirqama ta'us, inni garuu bakka namni hin jirreetti bahuun vidiyoo gadi xiqqeessu miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti gadhiisuun isaa mufannaa uume. Turistiin kun gocha isaa irratti gaabbee dhiifama gaafatus, mootummaan Bali aadaa fi amantii naannichaa kabachiisuuf jecha tarkaanfii cimaa kana fudhateera.

title: After GERD, can Egypt shape Ethiopia’s next Nile dams?
english: Ethiopia is moving forward with plans to build three new hydropower dams on the Blue Nile following the recent launch of the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam. This development presents a fresh challenge for Egypt, which previously failed to block the earlier project through its long-standing opposition. Cairo is now focusing on diplomacy and regional cooperation to manage these upcoming projects, as the ultimate impact on downstream water flow remains uncertain.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የታላቁ የኢትዮጵያ ህዳሴ ግድብን በቅርቡ ካጠናቀቀች በኋላ፣ በዓባይ ወንዝ ላይ ሶስት ተጨማሪ የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ግድቦችን ለመገንባት እቅድ ይዛ እየተንቀሳቀሰች ነው። ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል የህዳሴ ግድብ ግንባታን ለማስቆም በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ሳይሳካለት ለቀረው የግብፅ መንግስት አዲስ ፈተና ሆኗል። ግብፅ አሁን ባላት የውሃ ፍሰት ላይ ሊኖር የሚችለውን ተፅእኖ ለመቆጣጠር ከሱዳን ጋር በመተባበር እና በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች ላይ ትኩረት አድርጋ እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Itoophiyaan hidha haaromsaa guddicha erga xumurte booda, harcaatii laga Abbayyaa irratti hidha elektirikii biraa sadii ijaaruuf karoorfachaa jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun biyya Gibxii kan kanaan dura hidhicha dhaabuuf yaaltee hin milkoofneef qormaata haaraa ta'ee jira. Gibxiin amma dhiibbaa hidhonnii kun bishaan laga Abbayyaa irratti geessisuu danda'an to'achuuf jecha, biyyoota ollaa waliin marii fi dipiloomasii irratti xiyyeeffachaa jirti.

title: US vows to 'collapse' Iran with new sanctions as energy prices spike
english: The United States has announced plans to impose the most severe sanctions ever against Iran in an effort to destabilize the country's government. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that these new measures, combined with an ongoing blockade, are designed to cripple the Iranian economy. President Trump also warned that any nations that provide assistance to Iran will face significant economic repercussions.
amharic: አሜሪካ የኢራንን መንግስት ለማዳከም እስካሁን ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል አስታውቃለች። የግምጃ ቤት ሚኒስትሩ ስኮት ቤሰንት እንደተናገሩት፣ አዲሱ ማዕቀብ እና በኢራን ላይ የተጣለው እገዳ የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ በእጅጉ እንደሚጎዳው ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ለኢራን ድጋፍ የሚሰጡ ማናቸውም ሀገራት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስጠነቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ameerikaan mootummaa Iraan dadhabsiisuuf jechuun guyyoota dhufan keessatti tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa ta'e fudhachuuf karoorfattetti. Ministirri bajataa Ameerikaa Sakoottii Beesant akka ibsanitti, qophiin kun fi dhiibbaan diinagdee cimaan Iraanirratti godhamu biyyattii gadi baasuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Preezidaant Traampis gama isaaniitiin, biyyootni Iraaniif gargaarsa taasisan kamiyyuu adabbii diinagdee cimaa akka keessatti beekameef akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push while balancing US and Chinese tech
english: The Brazilian government is investing approximately $444 million to advance its artificial intelligence infrastructure while strategically balancing partnerships with both the United States and China. Half of the funding will support a project with Chinese firms Huawei and iFlytek to develop language models, while the remainder is earmarked for a powerful supercomputer likely to be supplied by the American company Nvidia. This approach aims to boost national data sovereignty and avoid over-reliance on any single nation or technology provider.
amharic: የብራዚል መንግስት አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ መሰረተ ልማቱን ለማሳደግ ወደ 444 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ ኢንቨስትመንት አቅዷል። ሀገሪቱ ከአሜሪካ እና ከቻይና ኩባንያዎች ጋር ባላት የቴክኖሎጂ አጋርነት ሚዛኑን የጠበቀ አካሄድ በመከተል፣ የቻይናዎቹን ሁዋዌ እና አይፍላይቴክ ለቋንቋ ሞዴሎች፣ የአሜሪካን ኩባንያ ኤንቪዲያን ደግሞ እጅግ ኃይለኛ የሆነውን ሱፐር ኮምፒውተር ለመገንባት መርጣለች። ይህ ስልት ሀገሪቱ በቴክኖሎጂ ላይ ያላትን የራስ ገዝነት ለማጠናከር እና በአንድ ሀገር ላይ ብቻ ጥገኛ ላለመሆን ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Braazil damee 'Artificial Intelligence' cimsuuf investimentii tilmaamaan $444 miiliyoonaa ta'u ramadeera. Braazil michummaa biyyoota lamaan, Ameerikaa fi Chaayinaa gidduutti wal-qixxeessuuf, hojiiwwan teeknoolojii gurguddaa hiriirsiteetti. Hojiiwwan kanaanis dhaabbilee Chaayinaa Huawei fi iFlytek waliin ta'uun modeleewwan afaanii yoo gabbisan, kutaansaa hafe ammoo kompiitara guddicha 'Supercomputer' jedhamu kan Ameerikaa Nvidia irraa argachuu malu ijaaruuf oola. Adeemsi kun mootummaan Braazil biyyoota kanatti hirkattummaa xiqqeessuufi of danda'uuf kan itti fayyadamaa jirtuudha.

title: Panama Canal to limit shipping ahead of extreme weather during El Nino
english: The Panama Canal Authority is reducing daily ship transits starting in September to manage lower water levels caused by the El Nino weather phenomenon. These limits will initially cap daily traffic at 34 vessels, dropping further to 32 later in the month to conserve water resources. This move may lead to shipping delays and higher costs, as the canal is a vital route for global trade that usually supports more frequent passage.
amharic: የፓናማ ካናል ባለስልጣን በኤል ኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ምክንያት የሚከሰተውን የውሃ መጠን መቀነስ ለመቆጣጠር በሴፕቴምበር ወር መጀመሪያ ላይ የሚያልፉ መርከቦችን ቁጥር ለመቀነስ ወስኗል። የውሃ ሀብትን ለመቆጠብ ታስቦ በተወሰደው በዚህ እርምጃ፣ በየቀኑ የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ቁጥር መጀመሪያ ወደ 34፣ ከዚያም ወደ 32 ዝቅ ይላል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዓለም አቀፍ ንግድ ላይ ተጽዕኖ በመፍጠር የትራንስፖርት መዘግየትን እና የዋጋ ጭማሪን ሊያስከትል ይችላል።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa maariyaa Paanaamaa sababa jijjiirama qilleensa 'El Nino' tiin sadarkaan bishaanii waan hir'ateef, ji'a Fulbaanaa irraa eegalee lakkoofsa dooniiwwan darban murteessuuf karoorfateera. Bishaan qusachuuf jecha, dooniiwwan guyyaatti darban jalqaba gara 34, ergasii ammoo gara 32 tti gadi buusuuf murtaa'eera. Tarkaanfiin kun daldala idil-addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumee, tursiisa geejjibaa fi gatii meeshaalee dabaluu danda'a.

title: Antigovernment protesters take to Tunisia’s streets for second month
english: Protesters in Tunisia are holding ongoing demonstrations to demand the resignation of President Kais Saied and an end to his authoritarian rule. The public is frustrated by a deepening economic crisis that has caused shortages of essential goods, rising costs, and failing public services. Additionally, activists and human rights organizations have criticized the government for its harsh crackdown on political opponents, journalists, and civil society members.
amharic: በቱኒዚያ የሚገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች የፕሬዚዳንት ቀይስ ሰኢድን ስልጣን መልቀቅ እና የአንድ ሰው አገዛዝ እንዲያበቃ በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ። በሀገሪቱ የኑሮ ውድነት መባባስ፣ የቁሳቁስ እጥረት እና የመሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች መስተጓጎል በህዝቡ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ቅሬታ ፈጥሯል። በተጨማሪም የመብት ተሟጋቾች መንግስት በተቃዋሚዎች፣ በጋዜጠኞች እና በሲቪል ማህበረሰብ አባላት ላይ የወሰደውን እርምጃ በጽኑ አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Tunisiyaatti namoonni hedduun pirezidanti Qays Sa'iid aangoo gadhiisanii fi sirni bulchiinsa nama tokkoo akka xumuramu gaafachuun hiriira mormii geggeessaa jiru.
